scope: The standing race control tower on the first paddock at Mobility Resort Motegi, including its distinct pale upper box, open roof deck and flank access stair.

originalReview.notes: Exact April 2008 photograph published on Qualla. The first revision states self-made and all rights released with PD-self. The archive records the change from Ajtnk to Ajtnk~commonswiki without a change of photographer.
